comment: The slew jack is dead: SLEW_INPUT has an enum entry and a panel jack but is never read in process(). The README documents it as a working CV input. The reset button is momentary and forces n to the reset value on every sample it is held, so the map is frozen while it is down. The slew law is rate = 10 + (20000 - 10) * (1 - slew)^6 per second.
